author: Megan Scott
content:
Booked a bouncy castle/slide for my son's 4th birthday party yesterday. The email communication was brilliant with the company from day of enquiring right up to day of event when the bouncy castle was delivered, set up and given a clean over in plenty of time before the kids arrived. Castle was immaculate 👌 The guy who dropped it off was brilliant - really friendly and on time for pick up which was so handy for us to manage to get the venue cleaned up.

I'd recommend using USB Events and I will be using in future.

5/5

Thanks guys !
